title: Final Power Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the threshold power, including all relevant constants and variables.

title: Diffraction Angle Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the diffraction angle to the diameter and wavelength using the formula theta_d = 1.22 lambda_n / D.

title: Critical Electric Field
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expression for the critical electric field E_c necessary for total internal reflection.

title: Poynting Vector Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the average Poynting vector for the electromagnetic waves in the medium.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes, particularly in the inequalities involving the index of refraction.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as constants and coefficients, are included in the final expression.
